# Okanagan Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram

> Okanagan Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram is a  dealership in Kelowna. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/okanagan-chrysler-dodge-jeep-ram-mirror/used/): 609 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/okanagan-chrysler-dodge-jeep-ram-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, index of all vehicles with VIN, year, make, model and price; full details are on each vehicle page
